name: warehouse_zoned_100
description: Zoned warehouse for the 100-AMR scale scenario. 24x12 grid of aisle intersections (138 m x 66 m), partitioned into 24 zones as 6 column bands x 4 row bands. Every aisle is a single lane travelled one way, on the same directed-perimeter layout as the 30-AMR floor. Requires 16-bit ids (540 edges exceeds the 8-bit ceiling of 255). Zone count is set by the NFR-1.12 frame budget under FR-9.3 adjacent-zone eligibility -- see ZONE_BUDGET_NOTE in scripts/generate_maps.py.
